# Cloudflare — Cloudflare for Startups

Enterprise-level Cloudflare credits in three tiers keyed to how much the startup has raised: $10k, $100k or $350k. Credits are valid for one year or until fully consumed. Tiers 1 and 2 require funding from an affiliated partner.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [☁️ Cloud](../categories/cloud.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $350,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Credits are valid for one year or until fully consumed, whichever comes first. |
| **When it ends** | Graduating startups are offered three paths: move to a self-serve plan, downgrade to a Free plan, or stay on Enterprise. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 3 | $10,000 | Bootstrapped or self-funded | No partner needed |
| Tier 2 | $100,000 | Under $5M raised | A partner code is required |
| Tier 1 | $350,000 | $5M+ raised | A partner code is required |

### Not covered

- Registrar Services
- AI Gateway
- Enterprise Feature Add-Ons

> **Stacking:** The Startup Plan is a one-time opportunity per startup and credits cannot be transferred. Credits are non-transferable, nonrefundable, non-redeemable for cash.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Shared requirements across all tiers: "Founded within the last 10 years", "Building a technology product", "a valid, publicly accessible website", "Active on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), or GitHub", "Has not previously been approved into the program", and "For-profit business with a business email matching your domain". open_to_bootstrapped is set true only because Tier 3 names "Bootstrapped or self-funded" explicitly. new_customer_only is left unknown: the page bars companies previously approved into the program, which is not the same as barring existing Cloudflare customers. Some advanced features must be manually enabled by Cloudflare before use. A separate Cloudflare page at https://www.cloudflare.com/startups/ carries the same program and states "Receive up to $350,000 in credits for a year to support your startup." Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
